version.changelog: Shorten description for listing; webhook copy uses API-key-only credential

llm.summary: The skill's requirements and instructions match its stated purpose (making outbound AI phone calls) and request only a single service API key; nothing in the skill appears incoherent or disproportionate.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and runtime instructions all describe outbound AI phone calls, IVR navigation, SDK/CLI usage and webhooks. The single required env var (PAMELA_API_KEY) and the suggested language runtimes (Node/Python) are consistent with this purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md contains only usage examples (JS/Python/CLI), installation suggestions for SDKs, and webhook info — it does not instruct reading unrelated files or system credentials. Note: the skill enables making calls to arbitrary phone numbers and sending audio/transcripts to Pamela's servers/webhooks, which can expose personal data and incur billing; this is expected behavior but important to consider.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: This is an instruction-only skill (no install spec and no code files). The README recommends installing npm/pip packages from named packages (@thisispamela/*, thisispamela), which is proportionate and standard for an SDK-centric integration.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Only PAMELA_API_KEY is declared as required and is the primary credential — this is appropriate for a service-backed API. No unrelated secrets, system config paths, or extra credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is not always-enabled (always:false) and does not request elevated or system-wide persistence. Model invocation remains enabled (the platform default), which is normal; the skill does not request to modify other skills or system configuration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent, but before installing consider: 1) Verify the service domain (thisispamela.com / developer.thisispamela.com) and that you trust the provider. 2) Expect billing for calls — test with low-cost numbers and monitor usage. 3) The API key (PAMELA_API_KEY) grants the service the ability to place calls and access transcripts; store it securely (not in public repos) and use least-privilege keys if the provider supports them. 4) Webhooks deliver transcripts and events to your endpoints — verify webhook signatures and avoid sending sensitive data to third parties. 5) Ensure you have consent to call and share phone numbers/transcripts (privacy/regulatory concerns). 6) If you don’t want the agent to autonomously place calls, restrict invocation or review agent permissions before enabling. Absence of code/scan findings only means there was no file-level code to analyze — it does not guarantee the provider or SDK packages are safe; review the upstream packages and documentation before use.
